legacy_isolation.surface: inactive provider catalog entries and placeholder metadata
historical divergent branches and stale local main worktree

known_limitations: Shared customer records remain user scoped until the explicit organization and business scope migration in Phase 202; current member routes enforce per-user ownership and admin access requires internal audience and step-up.
The legacy multipurpose 3D component remains only as an embedded drawing engine behind the canonical projection and shared view-state adapter; it is not a canonical data authority.
Phase 199 certification, secure JSON production reconciliation, exact-SHA deployment, and authenticated readback remain blocked until the mandatory GPT-5.6 Pro verdict is recorded.
